# gpu_warp_test's monochrome pointer (DXGI_OUTDUPL_POINTER_SHAPE_TYPE_MONOCHROME, README WA33): 16x16, the colors
# encode the mask bits (gpu_warp_support.h's MonochromeShape): k AND 0 XOR 0 (black), w AND 0 XOR 1 (white),
# '.' AND 1 XOR 0 (transparent), x AND 1 XOR 1 (invert: an I-beam, drawn black with a white outline).
size 16 16
palette
k FF000000
w FFFFFFFF
. 00000000
x 00FFFFFF
